How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for KMCLU Project/ Research Assistant Recruitment 2026 via email should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience. Attach self-attested copies of all required documents such as educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs. Clearly mention the post applied for in the subject line of the email. Send the complete application to the official email address mentioned in the notification. Ensure the email is sent before the last date: 30-09-2026. Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the KMCLU Project/Research Assistant recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your email application for the KMCLU Project/Research Assistant position is 30th September 2026. Ensure your application reaches the university before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the eligibility criteria for the Project/Research Assistant post?
faq.answer: To be eligible for the Project/Research Assistant position, candidates must have a Post Graduate degree with a minimum of 50% marks in any discipline.

faq.question: Q3. What is the salary offered for this position?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the Project/Research Assistant role will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 15,000 per month.

faq.question: Q4. How will candidates be selected for the Project/Research Assistant role?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Project/Research Assistant position will be based on a Walk-in Interview. Candidates are advised to prepare accordingly.

faq.question: Q5. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee required for applying to the Project/Research Assistant position at KMCLU, regardless of the candidate's category (General, OBC, SC, ST).

faq.question: Q6. What is the job type for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The position of Project/Research Assistant at KMCLU is on a contractual basis.

faq.question: Q7. Where is the Khwaja Moinuddin Chishti Language University located?
faq.answer: Khwaja Moinuddin Chishti Language University is located in Lucknow, Uttar Pradesh, with the pincode 226013.

faq.question: Q8. What is the advertisement number for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The advertisement number for this recruitment drive is KMCLU/Edu/2026.

faq.question: Q9. What documents are required to be attached with the application?
faq.answer: Candidates need to attach self-attested copies of educational certificates, experience certificates (if any), ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs with their application.

faq.question: Q10. When is the Walk-in Interview scheduled?
faq.answer: The Walk-in Interview for the Project/Research Assistant position is scheduled to be held on 12th October 2026.
